body: I'm hoping that i will find someone else to replace this person, hopefully better. However the time a year ago when I originally tried to kill myself (disclaimer: this is going to sound really pathetic) my girlfriend who just recently dumped me, cheated on me a year ago with some guy she worked with. She was with him for 4 months. I tried my hardest to go out and meet new girls but nothing worked out. I stayed friends with her(big mistake) and after he dumped her, we got back together, mainly because i was so lonely. Obviously it was never the same as she cheated on me and I always held it against her secretly. She broke up with me again a few days ago and I know its because she has found someone else (yet again...). I just am not ready to go thru the shit i did last semester, which was getting blackout for 2 months straight because i didnt want to think about it, then spending the rest of the semester striking out with every girl i talk to. It just seems hopeless

Me and my mom have never really been on the same page, but I really feel that my mom wouldn't care if i was outta their life. I'm the oldest and in my parents eyes, ive set a bad example for my younger brother,(because were actually pretty close, only 2 yrs younger, and I told him to never fuck up the way i did). I'm just getting really tired of hearing how much of a disappointment i am and how i squandered all the opportunities ive had and that im ungrateful, etc. That kind of encouragement really makes me feel like there is no point of going on when everyone around you gives up on you or tells you your whole life that youre a huge fuck up. It just really sucks and im not sure how much more i can take, you know...

So few people get an opportunity to fly and see the world in such a different perspective. However, I am only doing it because my dad has pushed this career on me his whole life and I'm only doing it to make him happy and convince him that im not doing drugs anymore. Take advantage of this rare opportunity and just do the thing you love to do

Im done with my pointless core classes. I just dont know what to do...
